Satellite name MIST (MIiniature Student saTellite)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Organisation Royal Institute of Technology (KTH)
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters Sweden
Partners Nanospace, Institute of Space Physics, Piezomotor AB
Oneliner

Test various technologies including propulsion system, mass spectrometer and piezoelectric motor.
Description

Prototype Cubesat propulsion system. Test of key parts of a mass spectrometer. Test of piezoelectric linear motor. X-ray Background Explorer. Test of SiC operational amplifier Integrated Devices and Circuits. Microfluidic Orbital Resuscitation of Bacteria. New method for trapping data errors.
